about:
Hi, I’m Shan-D, a producer and DJ from Nottingham. I started DJing in 2008 and began producing around 2010. The early sounds of dubstep shaped the music I make, with inspiration from Skream, Joker, Kryptic Minds, Chase & Status and more.

I release my own tunes and remixes, and share DJ sets too. The catalogue includes the five-track Dub In My Veins EP and the Average Man (Shan-D Remix) EP with Mr Naylor.

I share new music and “Dub Of The Day” clips on Instagram. Here you can browse my releases, play my mixes and find my next show. Thanks for listening and supporting the music — keep steppin’.
